solution.text: The circuit diagram can be redrawn as For the loop $A B C D A$, $$ +2-2 I^{\prime}+2-2 I=0 $$ For the loop $A B F E A$, $$ \begin{array}{r} 2-2 I+2-2\left(I-I^{\prime}\right)=0 \\ 4-2 I-2 I+2 I^{\prime}=0 \end{array} $$ $$ \begin{aligned} 4-4 I+2 I^{\prime} &=0 \\ 2 &=2 I-I^{\prime} \end{aligned} $$ From Eqs (i) and (in), we get $$ 2=2 I-I^{\prime} \cdot 2=I+I^{\prime} $$ $$ 4=3 I, I=4 / 3=1.33 \mathrm{A} $$
